projects.name: Learning Continuum & Aspire4Education
details: • Designed and developed scalable enterprise application modules using .NET Core, Razor
Pages, and SQL Server
• Worked on an ASP.NET Core application with a microservice-based architecture, where
business capabilities such as Student, Grading, Strategic, and System were implemented as
separate API services.

components, improving usability and responsiveness
• Built reusable and maintainable React components using effective state management, props
handling, and client-side validations
• Integrated React front-end applications with RESTful APIs, ensuring efficient data exchange
and optimized performance
• Improved UI performance by reducing unnecessary re-renders, optimizing API calls, and
enhancing load times
• Managed deployment of Aspire4Education REST APIs to Azure App Service, including
application publishing, environment configuration, and deployment validation.
• Designed and deployed SSRS reports to support business reporting and data-driven decision- making.

service interfaces

high-priority payment flows
